title: Opal Immersive Visor Prime
description: Meta Quest 3 — mixed-reality headset is the nominative anchor for this record. The Opal Immersive Visor Prime carries the same working details — Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 with 8 GB of RAM, starting at $499 — rendered as a fully original Signature work. It reached the market in 2023, aimed at mainstream VR users.
